title: (Physical) Security Specialist Intern - 2027 Internship, DUB West
description: **Description** Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. You will collaborate with security vendors, analyze operational data, and help identify improvements to surveillance systems, access controls, and security procedures. This is not a desk-only role. You will engage directly with the people, systems, and processes that keep Amazon's most critical infrastructure safe. What You Will Do * Coordinate with vendors involved in new security construction, repairs, daily security operations and patrols, and planning. * Analyze security metrics and data to identify trends and recommend improvements * Make suggestions on improving electronic surveillance systems and access controls * Help develop and deliver guidance to data center occupants on reducing false alarms * Write reports and create presentations on the status of physical security operations for management * Assist with planning and coordinating security-related projects * Support incident documentation and follow-up processes Internship Structure Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday through Friday. Please note that a full-time Security Specialist position could involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position. Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying. Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go. From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will help protect the infrastructure that keeps AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale. * Impact. Your work protects the physical infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. The security operations you support keep Amazon's most critical facilities safe and running. * Action. You will move fast, analyze real security data, and make recommendations that get implemented. Your ideas do not stay theoretical — they get tested and put into practice. * Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will learn how physical security operates at world-class scale and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon. * Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape. **About The Team** AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. **Basic Qualifications** * In pursuit of a Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Risk Management, Business Administration, Security Management, or a related field, graduating in 2027/2028 * Strong communication skills, both written and verbal * Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience communicating technical details verbally and in writing * Interest in physical security operations, including surveillance systems, access controls, and incident response * Interest in analyzing data to identify security gaps and recommend improvements * Familiarity with security policies, procedures, and compliance frameworks Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Analyst – Real Estate Lending
description: **Analyst – Real Estate Lending** Location: Dublin (hybrid) · Experience: 0–2 years, graduates welcome · Full-time, permanent · **About Elgin** Elgin is a Dublin-based real estate lender specialising in development finance for property developers across Ireland, alongside selective bridging loans. We fund schemes across multiple asset classes, including residential, build-to-rent, mixed-use, student accommodation, care homes, industrial and hospitality. We offer borrowers speed, certainty and flexible structuring. Our loans typically range from €3m to €50m. **The role** We're hiring an Analyst to join our lending team and work on deals from first enquiry through to repayment. You'll build and review the analysis behind our lending decisions, help prepare credit papers, and track live loans through construction and exit. This is a hands-on role in a small team. You'll work directly with senior lenders primarily on development loans, from site acquisition through construction to sales or refinance, along with bridging transactions. You'll learn quickly how real estate credit is structured, priced and managed. **What you'll do** * **Development underwriting:** Build and review development appraisals and cash-flow models. Size and price loans on loan-to-cost, loan-to-GDV and loan-to-value. Assess sponsor financial statements, track records and exit strategies, whether sales, refinance or sale of the assets. * **Bridging loans:** Support the team on bridging deals by reviewing valuations, business plans and the borrower's route to refinance or sale. * **Market research:** Research new-home sales prices, local comparables, planning context, construction costs, demand drivers and sector trends across residential, commercial and mixed-use markets to support credit decisions. * **Due diligence:** Coordinate with valuers, quantity surveyors, monitoring surveyors and solicitors. Review valuation, QS, planning, title and building reports and flag key risks. * **Credit papers:** Prepare sections of credit papers and presentations for the investment committee and our capital partners. * **Loan monitoring:** Review construction drawdown requests against monitoring surveyor reports and cost-to-complete. Track covenants, sales progress and loan performance, and prepare periodic reporting for our capital partners. * **Pipeline and reporting:** Maintain the deal pipeline, loan records and portfolio data, and help keep our internal processes running smoothly. **What we're looking for** * A degree in a quantitative subject such as finance, economics, engineering, quantity surveying or property (minimum 2:1 or equivalent) * Up to 2 years' experience in real estate, banking, lending, valuation or corporate finance. Strong graduates are welcome to apply. * Strong Excel skills and comfort building cash-flow models. You'll be trained on our own lending models. * Clear, concise writing and the confidence to present your analysis * Careful attention to detail and the ability to manage several live deals at once * A genuine interest in property, construction and credit **Nice to have:** exposure to development appraisals, real estate valuation or loan documentation, or progress towards a professional qualification (CFA, ACA, SCSI/RICS). **What we offer** * **Real responsibility early:** You'll work on live deals from day one, from origination through to repayment, rather than a single slice of the process. * **Breadth of experience:** You'll see development schemes across a wide range of asset classes, from site acquisition through construction to completion, plus selected bridging deals. * **Direct access to senior lenders:** In a small team, you'll sit in on credit discussions, borrower meetings and site visits. **How to apply** Send your CV and a short cover note to loans@elginpf.ie, with "Analyst – Real Estate Lending" in the subject line. Elgin is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of background.

title: Graduate Programme, Audit - Dublin (Sept 2027)
description: **Job Description** **Why Start Your Career at S&W?** Starting your career is about more than just a job. It's about the people you learn from, the relationships you build and the experiences that shape you. Whether that's passing an exam, achieving a personal milestone or celebrating success with your colleagues, you'll be part of a team that's invested in your growth, celebrates your successes and supports you to be yourself. At S&W, you'll be given meaningful work from day one, while having the support, training and encouragement to help you succeed. You'll learn by doing, working alongside experienced colleagues, contributing to real projects and developing valuable professional skills from the start. As your confidence grows, so will your opportunities, with plenty of support along the way. As a growing accountancy and advisory firm, we offer a balance of opportunity and support. You'll learn from people at every level of the business, gain exposure to a variety of clients, industries and experiences, and develop the skills, knowledge and confidence needed to build a successful career. **The Audit & Assurance Team at S&W** Our Audit & Assurance team works with a diverse range of clients, from entrepreneurial and family-owned businesses to charities, not-for-profit organisations and larger established businesses across a variety of industries. What sets Audit & Assurance at S&W apart is the breadth of experience you'll gain early in your career. You'll develop technical expertise, commercial awareness and a well-rounded understanding of how organisations operate, while working closely with experienced colleagues and gaining exposure to senior leaders and Partners. Together, this provides a strong foundation for a successful career in the profession. **What Will You Be Doing?** As part of our Audit & Assurance team, you'll work alongside colleagues to deliver services to a variety of clients. You'll be involved in different stages of an engagement, gaining insight into how organisations operate and the role assurance plays in building confidence in financial reporting. Alongside your role, you'll study towards the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) or Chartered Accountants Ireland (CAI) qualification. Through a combination of professional training and practical experience, you'll build a strong foundation in audit, accountancy and wider business advisory services. You'll be supported with funded training, dedicated study time and guidance from colleagues who have successfully completed the qualification themselves. Your work will include: * Analysing financial information * Testing processes and controls * Building relationships with client teams * Resolving audit and accountancy queries * Supporting a range of audit and accountancy projects Whether you're based in one of our offices or working directly with clients, you'll contribute to meaningful work from day one while building the skills and confidence needed to become a trusted adviser. **To Be Successful in This Role** You'll be someone who: * Is curious, eager to learn and open to new challenges * Enjoys working with others and building positive relationships * Has a keen eye for detail and enjoys solving problems * Is proactive and looks for ways to make a positive contribution * Takes ownership of their development and is motivated to achieve their goals You'll also need to: * Be committed to working towards the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) or Chartered Accountants Ireland (CAI) qualification * Have some accountancy experience, as part of your education or work experience * Have obtained or be predicted a minimum 2:2 degree, in any discipline * Minimum 400 Leaving Certificate points (or equivalent) * Leaving Certificate O2 or H5 in Maths and English (or equivalent) **Your Learning & Development** We'll support you throughout your qualification journey with a leading UK training provider, dedicated study time and practical experience that complements your learning. You'll join as part of a cohort and benefit from a support network that includes experienced colleagues, a buddy and our Learning & Development team, helping you make the most of the opportunities available to you. **As a Colleague at S&W, You'll Have Access to Benefits That Include** * Fully funded training towards professional qualifications * Competitive salary * Private medical insurance * Life assurance * Pension contribution * Generous holiday package * Option to purchase additional holiday * Cycle to work scheme * Season ticket loan * Eye care support * Shared parental leave **Our Commitment to Inclusion** We are proud to value the differences that a diverse workforce brings, representative of society and our clients. At S&W we have a wide range of highly active employee resource groups and we’re delivering multiple diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives across the organisation. It is our commitment to provide a workspace where all colleagues, regardless of identity, background, or circumstance, feel respected as individuals and feel that they can achieve their full potential and work in a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment. We are happy to make any reasonable adjustments to accommodate for your needs throughout the application process. Please let your Recruiter know. **IMPORTANT NOTES FOR COMPLETING YOUR APPLICATION** When you click on the **'I'm interested'** button, you'll be taken to your profile page. We're currently updating it, but in the meantime: * We can only accept one application to any of our programmes in a recruitment season. If you're unsuccessful, you'll need to wait until the following recruitment season to reapply. * Under the **Resume (CV)** section, uploading a document is mandatory and will be reviewed by the hiring manager.

title: Group Treasury Analyst
description: *We're looking for a curious, driven and adaptable Treasury professional (or accounting professional looking to move into Treasury) to join our Dublin-based team. Over the last several years, we have built a strong treasury platform, established robust operating frameworks, and developed a high-performing team. While the foundations are firmly in place, we continue to evolve, improve and challenge ourselves in pursuit of excellence.* *This is an opportunity to join an established team that still offers the pace, variety and opportunity of a dynamic environment. You'll gain exposure to a broad range of treasury, accounting, risk management and operational activities, while helping shape how Treasury supports the wider Group.* *If you're ready to commit, contribute and grow, we'd love to hear from you. Please send your CV and a cover letter explaining why this role is for you.* **Job Purpose** * With respect to the Group's Irish treasury entity (Aspen Treasury Ireland Limited or “ATIL”) to undertake day-to-day front and middle office operating activities and to provide dedicated support in the areas of accounting and reporting. * To undertake administrative, coordination and analytical activities that enable the efficient functioning of Group Treasury with the ultimate goal of ensuring the Group meets its treasury objectives as outlined in the Group Treasury Policy. **With respect to Aspen Treasury Ireland Limited:** **Non-operational activities** Under direction from the Group Executive: Treasury (“ **GET** ”) and the Group Head: Treasury (“ **GHT** ”), and ordinarily subject to review from the Group Treasury Controller (“ **GTC** ”) to undertake administrative, analytical or preparation activities aligned to ATIL’s risk and control matrix, the primary goal of which is to ensure ATIL meets its reporting, compliance and payment obligations on time and in full, which include but are not limited to: Preparing, producing, supporting and/ or contributing towards: * Company budgets * Internal Audit controls testing * Board meeting information pack * Capital adequacy assessment * Risk and control matrix and alignment thereof to workflow productivity system Review: * Third party and intragroup treasury-related invoices * Preparation and/ or review of monthly management accounts **Operational activities** * To undertake front office activities (i.e. pre-trade counterparty engagement, trade execution and capturing to ATIL’s treasury system) and middle office activities (i.e. near-term cash forecast review, FX exposure identification and measurement, trade recommendation, validating trades captured to ATIL’s treasury system, validating market data that is fed into ATIL’s treasury system) with respect to treasury-related facilities, instruments and trades, ensuring that such activities are undertaken timeously, correctly, efficiently and in line with ATIL’s strategy, risk tolerances and standard operating protocols; * Under direction from the GET, to undertake supporting activities with respect to management of ATIL’s bank and trading accounts with its banking counterparties, including account opening/ maintenance documentation, facilitating know-your-customer procedures, establishment and maintenance of mandates and standard settlement instructions, and the creation and maintenance of master data records in ATIL’s treasury system so as to ensure that ATIL is appropriately enabled to operate in accordance with its strategy; * To monitor ATIL’s banking fees, ensuring fees charged to ATIL are reasonable when compared to transaction volumes and annual price lists agreed to with the bank. **With respect to the Group’s overall treasury objectives:** Arising from the Treasury Policy: * Under direction from the GET and the GHT, to periodically undertake administrative and coordination activities, and to prepare analyses, with respect to certain of the Group’s treasury-related risks (i.e. interest rate, foreign exchange, liquidity, loan undertakings, counterparty, capital adequacy, cash optimisation) which are aimed at ensuring such risks are managed within risk tolerances stipulated in the Group’s treasury policy; * Contribute towards the Group Treasury Committee meeting information pack and/ or minutes and contribute towards the monitoring and measurement of the KPIs as per the Group’s treasury policy. In support of Group Treasury (as a Group-wide business function): * Under direction from the GET and the GHT, to undertake administrative and coordination activities with respect to the operating effectiveness of key risk management processes/ areas specific to Group Treasury (including its detailed risk and controls matrix and internal audit testing); * Under direction from the GET and GHT, and subject to review by the GTC, to undertake preparation, administrative and coordination activities with respect to the Group’s covenant compliance reporting and counterparties know-your-customer obligations; * In consultation with the GET and the GHT, to implement and realise new ways of working and technology enablers adding value through automation and simplification of existing workstreams; * To support the GET, GHT and/ or GTC with respect to administrative activities required to enable/ maintain Group entities’ transactional banking requirements; * With respect to small-to-medium-sized assignments: using a combination of standardised and innovative methods, tools or frameworks, to lead the technical execution of such assignments, including providing technical direction to other more junior professionals or specialists working thereon; * With respect to large assignments: under direction from the GET and the GHT, and with a limited degree of autonomy, to apply their technical knowledge in supporting the execution of such assignments. * Formal Qualification * Bachelor of Commerce or similar qualification * CA (IR) is preferred, but not required * CIMA/ Certificate in Treasury or similar accounting or finance-related qualifications is advantageous * Specific experience, Knowledge and registrations * Chartered Accountants Ireland is preferred, but not required * Financial services industry, or in the finance/ treasury division of a mid to large corporate * Accounting articles experience (preferably with financial services or treasury-type multinational clients) * +1 year post articles experience is preferred, but not essential * Knowledge of/ previous use of SAP Treasury **Work-specific Skills & Exposure Skills And Attributes** * Experience in communicating with a large number of stakeholders * Good understanding of financial accounting and internal controls * Well organised and methodical approach to tasks; * Excellent Excel, Word and Outlook skills; * Ability to multi-task and manage several tasks simultaneously; * Adherence to deadlines, and proactive management of stakeholder expectations in relation thereto; * Professional commitment to stakeholders; **Knowledge** * Moderate understanding or skill level in: * Corporate-treasury concepts and related financial instruments (including hedging instruments, loan agreements and guarantees) * Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook skills with the ability to apply these tools to a range of different scenarios * Irish company law and corporate processes #LD

title: Junior Property Management Coordinator (Trainee/ Apprentice)
description: Introduction The Junior Property Management Coordinator supports the organisation’s executive team while assisting with day-to-day property coordination and administration. This role is suited to someone currently studying real estate, property management or a related discipline who is seeking practical experience alongside their education, with the aim of progressing towards eligibility for a Property Services Regulatory Authority (PSRA) licence. Working under direction and supervision, the successful candidate will develop organisational, administrative and property coordination skills while helping ensure the smooth running of executive and property-related activities. Responsibilities will reflect the candidate’s training, experience and applicable licensing requirements. Contract Full-Time, Fixed Term Contract Responsibilities 1. Executive Support * Assist with managing and prioritising the executive team’s schedules, including meetings, travel arrangements and appointments. * Prepare and edit correspondence, communications, presentations and other documents as directed. * Act as a point of contact between executives and internal and external stakeholders, maintaining professional communication. 2. Property Coordination * Coordinate appointments and communications for agreed property maintenance, repairs and renovations. * Provide administrative support for agreed leasing activities, including tenant communications, lease documentation and rent collection records, under appropriate direction. * Maintain accurate records of property expenses, budgets and financial transactions as agreed by executives. * Develop an understanding of property management processes through practical tasks and guidance. Any activities requiring a PSRA licence will be undertaken only when the necessary licence is held. 3. Administrative Tasks * Organise and maintain confidential files and records, ensuring they are secure and readily accessible. * Assist with preparing reports, agendas and meeting minutes. * Manage office supplies and equipment, including inventory control and coordinating maintenance where required. 4. Communication and Liaison * Support communication between executives and other stakeholders, contributing to a collaborative and productive working environment. * Communicate with vendors, contractors and service providers as instructed by executives to support timely, quality service delivery. * Handle other reasonable requests from executives relevant to the role. Qualifications Skills * Good organisational and time-management skills, with attention to detail. * Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written. * Familiarity with office software, such as Microsoft Office Suite or Google Workspace, and a willingness to learn property management software. * Ability to prioritise tasks and manage competing demands. * A proactive approach, willingness to learn and ability to follow guidance. Education and Development * Currently undertaking, or enrolled to commence, a course in real estate, property management, auctioneering or a related discipline. * An interest in pursuing a career in property services and working towards a qualification that meets the PSRA’s requirements for the relevant licence category. * No completed property qualification or existing PSRA licence is required for entry to this trainee role. The position is intended to complement the successful candidate’s studies through relevant practical experience. Progression towards a PSRA licence will depend on meeting the Authority’s qualification and application requirements. Experience * No previous experience in executive assistance or property management is required. * Previous administrative, customer service or property-related experience is desirable. * A positive attitude, reliability and willingness to develop professionally are essential. Other Requirements * A full driving licence and access to a suitable mode of transport are required. This role offers an opportunity for a motivated student or trainee to gain practical experience while contributing to executive support and property coordination. There may be opportunities to progress into a broader property management role as qualifications, experience and licensing eligibility develop. The candidate must be available to report for work in both our offices, Rathmines Co. Dublin and Arklow, Co. Wicklow.

title: Junior Property Services Administrator & Receptionist
description: Junior Property Services Administrator & Receptionist **Introduction** Herman White is seeking an organised and enthusiastic Junior Property Services Administrator & Receptionist to join our team at our new office in Arklow, Co. Wicklow. This entry-level role is ideal for someone looking to begin a career in property administration or someone currently studying, or interested in studying, Real Estate Administration or a related course. Combining reception duties with administrative support, the position offers practical experience in a property services business. Working under direction and supervision, the successful candidate will help keep the office running smoothly while developing their skills and knowledge of the property sector. **Contract** Part-Time, fixed-term contract. **Location** The role is based at our new office in Arklow, Co. Wicklow. The successful candidate may also be required to report for work at our Rathmines, Dublin 6 office, depending on demand and operational needs. **Responsibilities** **1. Reception and Customer Service** * Welcome clients, visitors, contractors and service providers, creating a professional and friendly first impression. * Answer telephone calls, take accurate messages and direct enquiries to the appropriate team member. * Monitor shared email inboxes and respond to routine enquiries as directed. * Maintain a tidy, welcoming and organised reception area. **2. Property Services Administration** * Assist with preparing, updating and filing property-related documents, correspondence and records. * Support the team with arranging appointments, viewings, inspections and property access. * Update property listings, databases and internal systems as instructed. * Provide administrative support for sales, lettings and property management activities. * Record and pass on client, tenant and maintenance enquiries to the appropriate team member. **3. Office and Team Support** * Assist with managing diaries, scheduling meetings and preparing meeting documents. * Handle incoming and outgoing post, deliveries and document scanning. * Monitor office supplies and arrange replenishment as required. * Maintain accurate and confidential records, following company procedures. * Carry out other reasonable administrative duties to support the team across both offices. **4. Communication and Coordination** * Liaise professionally with clients, tenants, contractors and other stakeholders as directed. * Help coordinate appointments and communications relating to agreed maintenance and repairs. * Follow up on outstanding information and administrative tasks, keeping colleagues informed. * Ensure enquiries and messages are handled promptly and accurately. **Skills and Qualities** * Good organisational skills and attention to detail. * A friendly, professional manner and clear verbal and written communication. * Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office or similar software, with a willingness to learn new systems. * Ability to prioritise tasks and work collaboratively in a busy office. * Reliability, discretion and a proactive approach to learning. * An interest in property services and delivering good customer service. **Education and Experience** * No previous property industry experience or completed property qualification is required. * Suitable for someone seeking their first role in property administration or undertaking, or planning to undertake, studies in Real Estate Administration or a related discipline. * Previous reception, administration, retail or customer service experience would be an advantage. * Guidance and training will be provided to help the successful candidate develop in the role. **Other Requirements** * Ability to work primarily from our Arklow office and attend our Rathmines office when required. * A professional approach to handling confidential client and business information. **Career Development** This role offers an opportunity to build a foundation in reception, office administration and property services within Herman White. There may be opportunities to take on further responsibilities as skills, experience and relevant studies develop.

The successful candidate will have excellent numerical and analytical skills, a strong attention to detail and a genuine interest in developing a career in management accounting and financial management. They will be highly organised, proactive and capable of managing confidential financial information with the highest level of discretion, integrity and professionalism. **The Management Accountant will have the following responsibilities:** * Provide proactive, high-level support to the Head of Finance and Operations. * Assist in the preparation of management accounts and reports. * Develop annual budgets and periodic forecasts. * Monitor budget performance and analyse variances. * Perform cost analysis and profitability analysis. * Support year-end closing processes. * Prepare journal entries and balance sheet reconciliations. * Analyse revenue, costs, and business performance. * Partner with department managers to monitor spending and improve efficiency. * Identify opportunities for cost savings and process improvements. * Support strategic planning and business case preparation. * Ensure compliance with company policies and accounting standards. * Assist with internal and external audits. * Maintain and improve financial models and reporting tools. * Management and coordination including invoicing of ancillary income. title: Mechatronics Engineer for Spacecraft Avionics
description: **Company Background:** Réaltra Space Systems is a growing SME that delivers high-performance electronic units and avionics systems for world-leading space companies. Our activities include launcher cameras and avionics for Ariane 6 and the payload interface unit for ESA’s PLATO mission. We build innovative space products in a collaborative and supportive environment. We are proud supporters of the Irish space sector. Réaltra are now increasing our team to address the growing demand from the global space commercial and institutional sectors. If you are driven to deliver ambitious projects in space, we want to hear from you. **Position Overview** Réaltra is looking for a hands-on Mechatronics Engineer to design, integrate, assemble and test the mechanical, electronic and embedded computer systems that make up our avionics products for space applications. The role will focus on the design, build, integration and verification of flight and engineering units, taking them from kits of parts and sub-assemblies through to fully tested, documented hardware ready for delivery. The successful candidate will build on existing design, assembly, integration and test processes and functions. They will understand the constraints of spacecraft avionics, including mass, volume, power, thermal, vibration and shock, electrostatic discharge, cleanliness and contamination control, and the use of commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) electronics in the space environment. They will work within highly regulated industries quality expectations, customer audits, and the delivery documentation associated with flight hardware. The ideal candidate will have exceptional attention to detail and practical experience in the hands-on building of avionics, mechatronic or other electronic units. They will be comfortable working at the bench with mechanical assemblies, harnesses, connectors, printed circuit board assemblies and embedded processors, and with the test equipment, ground support equipment and software used to verify them. They must be comfortable working with engineering teams to support new product introduction activities, providing feedback on designs for ease of assembly, integration and test, and helping turn lessons learned into efficient and repeatable builds. Experience in a highly controlled industry such as space, aerospace, aviation, automotive or medical devices will be an advantage. Position Responsibilities * Write, review and execute assembly, integration and test procedures, work instructions and test reports. * Assemble and integrate mechanical, electronic and embedded computer sub-assemblies into complete avionics units for engineering, qualification and flight models. * Perform functional, performance and environmental testing (e.g. thermal, thermal vacuum, vibration, shock and EMC) of units and subsystems, and record and report results. * Bring up, configure and verify embedded computer systems, firmware loads and software interfaces as part of unit-level integration and test. * Design, build and maintain test set-ups, jigs, fixtures, harnesses and ground support equipment. * Work in cleanroom and ESD-controlled environments in line with space hardware handling, cleanliness and workmanship standards. * Investigate faults and test anomalies, support root-cause analysis and contribute to non-conformance handling and corrective actions. * Maintain as-built configuration records and support preparation of delivery documentation, including end-item data packages. * Determine and record updates to assembly and test processes as part of ongoing DFM/DFT operations * Support customer reviews, inspections and test witness activities. * Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce risk and support repeatable builds as product volumes increase. **Minimum Requirements** * 3 years' hands-on experience in mechatronics, electronics or similar systems, including assembly, integration and test of complex units. * Experience using 3D design tools such as Solidworks, Fusion, Autodesk * Professional level fluency in speaking, reading and writing in the English language is mandatory for this role. * Proven methodical approach and attention to detail. **Desirable** * Experience working in a highly regulated industry such as medical technology, aerospace or automotive. * Demonstrated hands-on experience building avionics, mechatronic or other electronic units. * Familiarity with space hardware standards (e.g., but not limited to, ECSS), workmanship standards (e.g. IPC) and ESD and cleanroom practices. * Experience with embedded systems, firmware and test automation (e.g. Python, LabVIEW or similar), and with laboratory test equipment. * Experience working in a small company environment and supporting customer audits. * Strong willingness to learn and be open to both receiving and making suggestions in a supportive way. **Competencies and Skills** * Attention to detail * Process driven * Delivery focus * Hands-on * Resourceful * Communicative * Supportive and collaborative At Réaltra, we are committed to building an inclusive, diverse, and collaborative team. We believe that a wide variety of perspectives drives creative solutions and strengthens our projects. We welcome applications from all talented individuals who share our passion for innovation in the space industry. **Salary:** Negotiable **Closing Date** : 20th November 2026 **Contact:** Please forward any enquiries related to this position to: careers@realtra.space

title: Network Operations Engineer I
description: **Job Overview** The Network Operations Engineer I is an entry-level technical role. Engineers I monitor, triage and maintain the health of Optical and IP networks in a 24x7 operational environment. This role is the first point of response for network alarms and incidents. It works closely with Network Operations Engineers II, who act as its escalation point, and with Team Leads to restore service and keep the network stable. The role is hands-on and follows defined procedures. Engineers I detect and acknowledge alarms, carry out first-level troubleshooting using established runbooks, open and document tickets, and support scheduled maintenance under guidance. Issues that go beyond first-level diagnosis are escalated promptly to Engineers II with clear initial findings. Engineers I build their skills through structured training, shadowing and mentorship. **Scope** * Serve as the first-level response point for optical and IP network alarms and incidents. * Monitor network health using NOC monitoring and alarm management tools, and acknowledge alarms within defined response times. * Perform first-level triage and troubleshooting following established runbooks and procedures. * Escalate incidents to Network Operations Engineers II with accurate initial diagnostics. * Create, update and maintain tickets with clear, accurate documentation. * Support scheduled maintenance activities and network changes under the direction of senior engineers. * Develop technical knowledge of optical and IP technologies through training, shadowing and mentorship. **Roles And Responsibilities** **Monitoring, Incident Response & First-Level Troubleshooting** * Monitor optical and IP network alarms, events and performance dashboards across a 24x7 environment. * Acknowledge, prioritise and triage alarms and incidents according to severity and defined response times. * Perform first-level troubleshooting of optical (DWDM, CWDM) and IP (IPv4/IPv6, MPLS, BGP, OSPF) networks using runbooks. This includes checking optical power levels, interface status, alarm states, protocol adjacencies and basic connectivity. * Gather initial diagnostic information such as logs, alarm history, interface counters and recent changes to support fault isolation. * Escalate incidents that cannot be resolved at first level to Network Operations Engineers II, with clear findings and the steps already taken. * Support senior engineers during major service-impacting incidents by running checks, gathering data and keeping tickets updated. **Ticket & Case Managemen** t * Create, update and close tickets with accurate, detailed and timely documentation for all work performed. * Open cases with vendor TACs (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Ciena, Nokia, Infinera) when directed, and provide the requested logs and diagnostics. * Track open tickets and vendor cases, and follow up to ensure timely progress. * Verify basic service restoration after an incident and record the outcome in the ticket. * Notify internal stakeholders and customers of incidents using approved communication templates. **Maintenance & Change Support** * Support scheduled maintenance activities and network changes under the direction of Engineers II or III, including pre- and post-change checks. * Follow approved method-of-procedure (MOP) documents and change management processes. * Assist with turn-up and testing of new circuits, services and network elements. * Coordinate with field technicians, colocation facilities, ISPs and service providers to arrange access, dispatches and testing. **Learning, Process & Collaboration** * Complete structured training and shadow senior engineers to build optical and IP troubleshooting skills. * Follow runbooks and procedures, and flag gaps or inaccuracies to senior engineers for update. * Contribute to knowledge-base articles under the review of senior engineers. * Participate in shift handoffs and produce clear, complete shift-turnover notes. * Work collaboratively with NOC colleagues, Engineering and other operational teams. **Required Qualifications & Skills** * Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 0–2 years of experience in network operations, IT support, or a related technical role; internships or lab experience are considered. * Foundational knowledge of IP networking (TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6 addressing, subnetting, routing and switching concepts), with awareness of BGP, OSPF and MPLS. * Basic understanding of optical transport concepts (DWDM, CWDM, fiber types, optics, patch panels) and optical power levels. * Familiarity with network device command-line interfaces (CLI). * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to follow procedures accurately. * Good written and verbal communication skills, including clear ticket documentation. * Willingness to learn, take direction and escalate appropriately. * Ability to work effectively in a 24x7 shift-based operational environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Associate-level certifications such as CCNA, JNCIA, Nokia NRS I, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent. * Exposure to multi-vendor network equipment (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Ciena, Nokia, Infinera). * Basic familiarity with fiber testing tools (OTDR, power meters, light sources). * Experience with NOC monitoring, alarm management and ticketing platforms. * Awareness of ITIL-based incident and change management processes. * Interest in scripting or automation (e.g., Python). **Physical Demands & Work Environment** * Ability to perform office-related tasks, including prolonged sitting or standing. * Capability to move within an office environment and effectively use a computer. * Must have strong communication skills for effective collaboration and coordination. * Occasional repetitive motions of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers may be required. * Availability to work rotating shifts, including weekends, and holidays as required in a 24x7 environment. **Salary Range** 45,280.00 - 56,600.00 EUR (Annual) * Please note that the salary information provided herein is base pay only (gross); it does not include other forms of compensation which may or may not apply to this specific position, namely, performance-based bonuses, benefits-related payments, or other general incentives - none of which are guaranteed, may be subject to specific eligibility requirements, and are wholly within the discretion of Astreya to remit. * Further, the salary information noted above is a range that consists of a minimum and maximum rate of pay for this specific position. Where an applicant or employee is placed on this range will depend and be contingent on objective, documented work-related considerations like education, experience, certifications, licenses, preferred qualifications, among other factors.

title: Software Engineer, Security Business Enablement
description: Who we are **About Stripe** Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. **About The Team** Security Business Enablement (SBE) is Stripe's commercial security function: the interface between Stripe's internal security program and its Go-to-Market organization. We make sure security and compliance requirements never block, delay, or devalue Stripe's deals. This work is about customer trust: businesses entrust Stripe with critical financial infrastructure, and their security teams need confidence that Stripe meets rigorous standards before, during, and after the sale. We make that trust tangible with accurate, consistent evidence of Stripe's security posture. We own security due diligence end to end: questionnaire response, compliance evidence, live security reviews, gap and exception management, contractual security exhibits, rapid response during industry-wide events, and executive briefings. We engage customers directly, up to CISO level, and equip sales teams to handle security conversations on their own. Our scope is unusually broad: one assessment can span security, privacy, business continuity, and resilience, translating deep control detail into language procurement, legal, and a CISO can each act on. We are often the first team asked to represent emerging parts of Stripe's posture. We work at the intersection of security, AI, and Go-to-Market. Our platform is built on authoritative grounding: answers are retrieved from a knowledge base we maintain and validate, not generated from first principles, so they are consistent and source-traceable. Our POC proved the concept and outgrew what agent builders alone can do; taking it to production quality is the engineering problem this role exists to solve. What you’ll do **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and scale an AI-powered platform that delivers validated answers to security questions on demand, for both the sales teams who ask them and the customers who need them, replacing inconsistent ad-hoc responses with consistent, source-traceable ones * Build the retrieval, content pipeline orchestration, and integration layers that off-the-shelf tooling cannot deliver, including support for multiple cloud environments and Stripe's full and growing product portfolio, so that answers stay accurate as Stripe's infrastructure and products evolve * Build automations that keep security content current as Stripe rapidly adopts new technologies and introduces new controls, including automated refresh and review cycles that route content to subject-matter experts and Legal for validation * Build the capability to manage industry-standard certifications and assessment frameworks, including the Shared Assessments SIG and the Cloud Security Alliance CAIQ * Build analytics and evaluation capabilities that measure and continuously improve the performance and coverage of the security content library * Extend the same platform and knowledge base to power a public and authenticated Trust Center, giving customers direct self-service access to Stripe's security, privacy, resilience, and compliance posture * Partner with security analysts and with Security, Privacy, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders to expand coverage across Stripe's full security surface area, and own the reliability and operational health of what you build Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. **Minimum Requirements** * 2+ years of software engineering experience building production systems * Strong coding skills in any programming language (we understand new languages can be learned on the job so our interview process is language agnostic) * Comfort working with retrieval-augmented architectures, content pipelines, and AI/LLM integrations, or demonstrated ability to learn quickly in these areas * Experience building workflow automation, including scheduled jobs, approval routing, and multi-stakeholder review processes * Comfortable instrumenting systems and working with data to measure quality, coverage, and performance, then using those measurements to drive improvement * Experience creating projects from scratch, taking ownership, and driving work to completion with minimal supervision * Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with non-engineering stakeholders (security analysts, sales teams, legal) * Seek out opportunities for impact and can execute in a complex, cross-functional environment **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building AI-driven products or workflows, particularly retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems or knowledge management platforms * Experience building evaluation frameworks for AI systems, such as measuring retrieval quality, answer accuracy, or coverage gaps * Familiarity with cloud security concepts across AWS and/or Azure * Previous experience with security software engineering, compliance tooling, or GRC platforms * Familiarity with security assessment frameworks and standards such as the Shared Assessments SIG, Cloud Security Alliance CAIQ, SOC 2, PCI DSS, or ISO 27001 * Experience with content management systems, structured content modeling, or documentation-as-code approaches * Experience building customer-facing or internal self-service tools at scale * Comfort working in a small team where individual contributions have outsized, visible impact In-office expectations Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. Pay and benefits The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is €85,000 - €127,600. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process. Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends. We look forward to hearing from you. At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us. Apply now Please find our EU applicant personal information notice here.

title: Graduate Electrical Engineer (Transmission & Distribution) - Dublin or Cork - May 27 onwards start
description: **Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.** At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. **Job Description** Our Transmission and Distribution team are currently seeking graduates to work in our **Dublin or Cork** offices from **May 27 onwards** . **About our Team** Committed to addressing the complete spectrum of energy challenges, we offer expertise in the following sectors: renewable energy (wind and solar), Battery Energy Storage Systems, hydropower, bioenergy (including energy from waste), energy efficiency and carbon management, thermal power generation, nuclear power and transmission and distribution. The Transmission & Distribution (T&D) Engineering team provides a range of services from the initial concept through Cabling, Substations, Transmission and Distribution Infrastructure, Protection Systems, SCADA, Communications, Converter Station Design, HVDC Systems and Interconnectors including overseas links. Regular site visits to construction sites for substations, cables and overhead lines would be a feature of this role. AECOM is part of the Great Grid Upgrade programme in a Joint Venture with Arup. As a partner within the programme, we are responsible for delivering design, environment and consenting services within the strategic programme of works. An example of the type of projects being delivered through the partnership by AECOM Arup is below. AECOM Arup have been selected as the design, environmental and consenting partner to lead on a complex project that must deliver a significant new overhead line circuit that connects several new and extended substations on the east coast of England. This work will require a multi-discipline team of engineers, environmental consultants and planning & consent consultants to determine the best option for this new overhead line. This will require detailed analysis of various routes considering multiple factors such as terrain, ground conditions, weather conditions etc when looking at the sighting of new overhead line towers. As part of this analysis there may be requirements to provide sections of underground EHV cables where the route crosses sensitive environments such as National Parks or Areas of Outstanding Beauty. There will be new substations along this route that will require siting studies followed by detailed design for the new HV plant solution, protection and control, civil engineering requirements and associated ancillary services. As the design, environment and consenting partner we will be involved throughout the construction phase to ensure any design development or alterations are undertaken in a timely manner. **Here's what you'll do:** The successful candidate will primarily be working on transmission assets in the Republic of Ireland or the UK, but the team is working on multiple projects in Europe and further afield and some international travel may be required. a Bachelor's degree, preferably in a scientific or related discipline, is preferred * Good understanding of clinical trial budgeting, costing processes and proposal development * **Advanced Microsoft Excel skills** , with proficiency in other Microsoft Office applications * Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and a logical, process-oriented approach * Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders * Fluent written and spoken **English** , with the ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team **What We Offer** In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs: * Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees * Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility) * One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.) * Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year! * Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September * Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition! * Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment * Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team! *Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.* **Our Services** * End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support * Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading * Precision medicine and biomarker solutions * Real-world evidence and clinical consulting * Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio **How to Apply** To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.* *Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.* **Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams** Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.
